info.title: Cisco IOS-XE Native Config - Interface — Physical & Basic
info.description:
Basic interface settings: shutdown, MTU, bandwidth, speed, duplex, description, MAC address.

**Representative type:** GigabitEthernet (paths work identically for TenGigabitEthernet, HundredGigE, Loopback, Vlan, Tunnel, etc. — just substitute the type name in the URL).

**All 57 interface types:** ATM, ATM-ACR, AppGigabitEthernet, AppNav-Compress, AppNav-UnCompress, Async, BD-VIF, BDI, Bundle, CEM, CEM-ACR, Cellular, Dialer, Embedded-Service-Engine, Ethernet, Ethernet-Internal, FastEthernet, FiftyGigabitEthernet, FiveGigabitEthernet, FortyGigabitEthernet...

get.description:
Retrieve name configuration from the device via RESTCONF.

Returns the current operational or configuration state of this resource.

put.description:
Create or replace name configuration on the device.

This replaces the entire resource — any fields not included will be removed.

patch.description:
Partially update name configuration on the device.

Only the fields included in the request body are modified; other fields remain unchanged.

delete.description:
Remove name configuration from the device configuration.

This deletes the resource and all descendant data.
